story.text: MoversHub connects people who need to move with <mov>independent movers</mov> who own vans. Pick a <veh>vehicle class</veh>, see an <pri>upfront price</pri>, pay by <pay>card</pay> and <trk>track your mover live</trk> on the map. Moving between Germany, Austria or Switzerland and home? Our <dia>diaspora corridors</dia> are built for exactly that.

faq.title:
Frequently
asked
questions.
faq.contact: Can't find an answer? <link>Contact us</link> and we'll be happy to help.

q1.a: Independent businesses with their own vans. Each one sets their own rates per vehicle and can accept or decline any job.

q2.a: By vehicle class, distance and crew size, using the rates your mover set. You see the full price before you book — no negotiating on the day.

q3.a: By card in the app. Payments are processed by Stripe and go straight to the mover; MoversHub takes a commission and never holds your money.

q4.a: Your mover is responsible for the goods they carry and must have carrier insurance. Report the issue in the app with photos, and we'll connect you with the mover and their insurer.

q5.a: Yes. Diaspora corridors cover Germany, Austria and Switzerland to and from Kosovo, Albania and North Macedonia, with movers who do these routes regularly.

q6.a: Yes — live on the map from the moment the mover is on the way, and you can share the tracking link with anyone.

q7.q: How do I become a mover?
q7.a: Sign up in the MoversHub Partner app, add your van and documents, set your rates and start accepting jobs once you are approved.
